I had a really good experience with Rock Suzuki, especially with Sufiyan. I recently came back from my village after 10 days and my Access 125 wouldn't start. I called the center and Sufiyan suspected rat damage. I was actually quite skeptical because I had already paid for rat protection from them a year ago, but Sufiyan came to my location to check. He couldn't fix it there, so he arranged a pickup immediately.

​When we reached the center, they confirmed the wire was badly cut by rats. To be honest, I got a little aggressive and argued with them because I felt the rat protection should have worked. But Sufiyan handled it very calmly. He explained clearly that while they provide a warranty, sometimes rats are just too aggressive, and he helped me understand the situation without getting rude.

​Then came a bigger issue—there was a major part failure which was going to cost ₹6000 to replace. I requested Sufiyan to see if anything could be done. He checked the records and found it was still under warranty. He replaced that ₹6000 part completely free of cost for me, which was a huge relief.

​On top of that, to help me further, he even removed the fitting and labor charges from the final quotation. He replaced the wiring, added new rat protection, and fixed the other issue. My total bill came to just ₹5302 including GST. I really appreciate his honesty and effort to save my money. Highly recommended!"

featured_reviews.name: Sanjari Jewellers
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with the service at Rock Suzuki (Byculla branch).

I had given my vehicle in the afternoon for servicing. The service executive, Mr. Zaid, clearly informed me that the service would be completed by 6:30–7:00 PM the same evening. However, when I reached the service center at 6:30 PM, I was shocked to see that my vehicle had not even been touched. It was parked exactly the way I had left it.

Instead of completing the service as promised, they created a job card estimating expenses of around ₹4,000, stating that multiple parts needed replacement. I was then asked to take a fresh appointment and come the next day before 11:00 AM, with the assurance that the vehicle would be ready the same day.

The next day, when I arrived on time with my Burgman Street, I was informed that the vehicle would only be delivered by 8:00 PM. This clearly shows a lack of professionalism, poor time management, and complete disregard for customers’ time.

Key issues I faced:
•	False commitments regarding delivery time
•	No service work done despite prior confirmation
•	Unnecessary parts replacement suggested without proper explanation
•	Poor communication and misleading information
•	Wastage of customer’s valuable time
•	Lack of transparency in billing and service process

This behavior makes customers feel cheated and disrespected. The same attitude reflects in their showroom as well — before selling a vehicle, they make big promises, but when it comes to after-sales service, the experience is extremely disappointing.

I would strongly advise others to be cautious before choosing this service center. Extremely unprofessional and unacceptable experience.

featured_reviews.review_text: Cars 24 has cheated me. I had seen a car on the casr 24 app and booked a test drive. After 2 days, I got a call from Car24 and I said that the car you had chosen has a token. Are you interested in another car? I told them yes. I visited Car24 Goregaon. There I chose a Renault Tiger car and since my civil is a little bad, I asked them if there will be a loan in my name. They said that you have already got free off offers from Car24. You book your car by paying 10000Rs. They told me all the procedures. Make a down payment of 60000 and take your car. I paid 10000Rs and booked the car and Cars 24 told me that you will pay 50000 Rs in 5 to 7 days and your car will be delivered. It has been 2 days and I have started getting calls from different finance companies. You are Cars 24.  Did you book a call from me? I said yes, after that, every day I got calls from different companies and every day I had the same question. After that, I contacted Cars 24. I just paid the Dp. I didn't get a call from them. They said cars24 is not worth it. They spent 15 to 20 days on it. They said cars 24 canceled my booking and refunded me only Rs 5000. These cars 24 people make people fools like this. They cancel your booking and refund me only Rs 5000. So my request is that while booking a car from Cars 24, think about it.

Lost a potential customer within minutes because nobody seemed interested in selling a car. Avoided wasting any more of my time and walked out.
